en.joke: My smart home speaker just suggested I automate my existential dread.
en.explanation: It's funny because it takes the concept of home automation and applies it to an un-automatable, abstract human emotion, highlighting the absurdity of tech solutions for everything.

people.name: Philippe Sands
people.bio: British/French lawyer, legal academic and author (born 1960)
people.extract: Philippe Joseph Sands is a British and French writer and lawyer at 11 King's Bench Walk and Professor of Laws and Director of the Centre on International Courts and Tribunals at the Faculty of Laws, University College London. A specialist in international law, he appears as counsel and advocate before many international courts and tribunals, including the International Court of Justice, the International Tribunal for the Law of the Sea, the European Court of Justice, the European Court of Human Rights and the International Criminal Court.
highlights: British and French writer and lawyer.
Professor of Laws at University College London.
Specialist in international law, appears before international courts.
